entities.summary: Paulina Petronela Krakowowa was a Polish writer, publicist, editor, teacher, and social activist. She was the founder and supervisor of a boarding school for girls in Warsaw which she ran from 1849 to 1879. She specialised in literature for children and young people including Diaries of a Young Orphan (1839) and Memoirs of an Exile (1845).
